theorems.statement: ∀ {X : Type} [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (B B' G G' : Set X) (Φ φ ψ : X → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (m : ℝ≥0∞), 0 ≤ M → MeasurableSet G → MeasurableSet G' → G' ⊆ B → G' ⊆ B' → IntegrableOn Φ B μ → (∀ x, |Φ x| ≤ M) → (∀ x ∈ (B \ G') ∩ G, Φ x = 0) → μ ((B \ G') \ G) ≤ m → m < ⊤ → AEStronglyMeasurable φ (μ.restrict G') → IntegrableOn ψ B' μ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ x) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ G' → |Φ x - φ x| ≤ M * ψ x) → |∫ x in G', φ x ∂μ| ≤ |∫ x in B, Φ x ∂μ| + M * m.toReal + M * ∫ x in B', ψ x ∂μ
